mechanism: Cenobamate induces CYP3A4/CYP2C9, reducing lamotrigine levels by approximately 40-50%, while lamotrigine may increase cenobamate levels through protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor lamotrigine levels closely; consider lamotrigine dose increase of 50-100% when used with cenobamate; counsel on breakthrough seizure risk and CNS effects; consider therapeutic drug monitoring.
